##### Project general facts

Oasiz 2 by Danube Properties is a contemporary residential tower located in Dubai Silicon Oasis, offering a modern lifestyle within a dynamic and well-connected district. Rising 31 storeys, the project stands out with its sleek architectural design and thoughtfully planned living spaces, creating a balance between urban convenience and a comfortable atmosphere for everyday life.

Each apartment is carefully designed to maximize space, light, and functionality, featuring open layouts and floor-to-ceiling windows that provide panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline. Select residences include private pools, adding an extra layer of exclusivity and comfort. The development also offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including an infinity pool, aqua gym, floating cinema, and dedicated children’s areas, enhancing both relaxation and social living.

The residences are fully finished with high-quality modern materials and include equipped kitchens designed for practicality and style. Apartments are offered furnished, ensuring a move-in-ready experience while maintaining a contemporary and elegant aesthetic throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Silicon Oasis is a cutting-edge technology park and residential community located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It spans over 7.2 square kilometres and is strategically situated on the Emirates Road, providing easy access to Dubai's major highways and landmarks.

As a hub for technology and innovation, Dubai Silicon Oasis is home to numerous multinational technology companies, startups, and research institutions. It offers state-of-the-art infrastructure and facilities tailored to the needs of the tech industry, including advanced telecommunications, data centres, and modern office spaces.

In addition to its technological prowess, Dubai Silicon Oasis is also a vibrant residential community. Residents enjoy a plethora of amenities, such as schools, healthcare facilities, shopping malls, parks, and recreational areas, creating a well-rounded and convenient lifestyle.
